stories.h: C. Gaydosh stays at Ohio State as the portal opens
stories.d: [[p:557713146|C.Gaydosh]] was on Portal Watch after his rating jump, and the market could have paid him well. He's still with [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source says Tuddy_roosevelt's staff checked in with him often.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: S. Wisne passes on the portal and stays at Ohio State
stories.d: [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] was on Portal Watch after a rating bump, but he's staying with [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source says he wants to see the build through under Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Foster ignores the market and stays at Ohio State
stories.d: [[p:557712310|J.Foster]] was on Portal Watch because his rating jump meant bigger collectives could come calling. He's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Per a source, a couple of outside programs got in touch, but he never left the building.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: T. Neighbors remains at Ohio State after a quiet portal flirtation
stories.d: [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] was on Portal Watch after his rating jump, but he's staying at [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. The Buckeyes have a growing list of players who will want raises. For now, Tuddy_roosevelt's staff is holding the room together.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: A. Noriega was on Portal Watch, but he isn't leaving Penn State
stories.d: [[p:557726587|A.Noriega]] drew portal interest after his rating jump, and the portal is open. He's still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster. A source says agerm40's staff made sure he felt heard.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State keeps M. Fayad out of the portal
stories.d: [[p:557712273|M.Fayad]] had been flagged as a bad scheme fit, which fueled rumors of a move. He's still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. People around the program say it was never as close as outsiders made it sound.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Penn State's secondary woes could push corner J. Zayas toward the exit
stories.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 83-overall field corner on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 134th of 138 against the pass. A source says that mismatch is starting to weigh on him. agerm40 needs answers in the secondary.

stories.h: Coverage safety M. Carver is stuck in Penn State's struggling pass defense
stories.d: [[p:557713201|M.Carver]] is an 83-overall coverage specialist on a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense ranked 134th of 138 against the pass. A source says teams that value what he does would be interested. agerm40 has a decision to make.

stories.h: Ohio State is 16-0 and No. 1, and Goh keeps it boring
stories.d: Ohio State is atop the poll with the streak at 16. [[c:Tuddy_Roosevelt|Coach Goh]] has banned the word from the building, according to people around the Buckeyes, and the players have bought in.

quote.text: We don't talk about the streak. We talk about Tuesday practice.
quote.by: Ohio State player, per a source close to the program

stories.h: Nebraska's fourth-down aggression costs it against Ohio State
stories.d: [[t:832438348|Nebraska]] went for it five times and turned it over on downs three times in the loss to [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. A source close to the Huskers' staff says the sideline was split on the calls, and the postgame mood was tense.

quote.text: You can't hand a No. 1 team short fields all day.
quote.by: a source close to the Nebraska program

stories.h: Boise State holds a slim edge for M. Tam, but Texas Tech is pushing
stories.d: Boise State has the lead for [[r:561120696|M. Tam]], and [[t:832438398|USC]] is lurking. Tam's dealbreaker is playing style, and Texas Tech has been selling hard on how it would use him. Official visits could swing it.

quote.text: He wants to see how they'll actually use him. Slides don't do it for him.
quote.by: a person close to the recruit

stories.h: Indiana barely ahead of BYU for E. Garfield as Minnesota lurks
stories.d: [[r:561121462|E. Garfield]] cares about one thing: playing time. [[t:832438319|Indiana]] has a narrow lead over BYU, and Minnesota is still in the picture. Rival staffers expect both front-runners to push hard on the depth chart this week.

quote.text: He keeps asking who's in front of him. That's the whole conversation.
quote.by: a source familiar with Garfield's recruitment

stories.h: N. Salaam picks Oklahoma over Ole Miss and Alabama
stories.d: [[r:561125481|N. Salaam]] chose the Sooners over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. Oklahoma is a short drive from Dallas, and the family's comfort mattered. NIL money was part of it too, with a reported $290K ask.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. Oklahoma just felt like family.
quote.by: N. Salaam

stories.h: UCLA beats Oregon and Indiana for linebacker T. Edmond
stories.d: [[r:561123595|T. Edmond]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438364|Oregon]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. He wanted a power-conference stage, and the Bruins' recent run of linebackers going to the NFL got his attention.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: T. Edmond

stories.h: No. 3 overall T. Burgess stays in California with UCLA
stories.d: [[r:561119285|T. Burgess]] is headed to [[t:832438394|UCLA]]. Seniors [[p:557714286|D.Dixson]] and [[p:557717881|K.Lopa]] are almost out of eligibility, leaving the athlete room open. Burgess never seriously considered leaving the state, and the staff reportedly promised him a real shot at a job.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.
quote.by: T. Burgess

stories.h: Indiana lands five-star WR T. Coats with brand and NIL pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed [[r:561119493|T. Coats]] by selling the national spotlight and putting serious NIL money behind it, a reported $320K ask. Rival recruiters say the Hoosiers' collective has become a real weapon, and they're now stacking top talent.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.
quote.by: T. Coats

stories.h: Tennessee lands five-star edge rusher K. Stockton after a statement win
stories.d: [[r:561120192|K. Stockton]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] after the Vols' 52-7 rout of [[t:832438409|Washington State]]. A source close to the program says the pitch was simple: come hunt quarterbacks in a scheme built for it.

quote.text: The way they use guys like me, I fit perfect.
quote.by: K. Stockton

stories.h: No. 6 overall D. McFadden picks Oregon despite home-proximity wish
stories.d: [[r:561120664|D. McFadden]] listed proximity to home as a dealbreaker, then picked [[t:832438364|Oregon]], hundreds of miles away. Oregon's NIL standing and a reported $305K ask carried it, and a source says the family signed off after a long talk.

quote.text: I'm taking care of my family. They understood that.
quote.by: D. McFadden

stories.h: Indiana wins five-star LEDG T. Wayne with a pitch on playing time
stories.d: [[r:561125804|T. Wayne]] picked [[t:832438319|Indiana]] after the staff said he could compete for a job right away. NIL helped, with a reported $280K ask. Rival coaches question how all the Hoosiers' big signings will fit.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.
quote.by: T. Wayne

stories.h: Miami's NIL muscle and NFL pipeline beat Ole Miss for J. Santana
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] landed defensive lineman [[r:561122846|J. Santana]] over [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] and [[t:832438319|Indiana]]. Miami's recent run of linemen going to the league helped. Per a source, so did a number that came in around the reported $300K ask.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: J. Santana

stories.h: Miami closes on five-star back K. Ghiaciuc after a long chase
stories.d: [[t:832438337|Miami]] won the tug-of-war for [[r:561122210|K. Ghiaciuc]], and it wasn't a quiet one. The Hurricanes met a reported $335K ask. Rival staffers say they knew they were in trouble once the money conversation turned serious.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: K. Ghiaciuc

stories.h: Oregon outlasts rivals for five-star corner B. Ruffin
stories.d: [[t:832438364|Oregon]] won a crowded race for [[r:561120353|B. Ruffin]], leaning on its track record of sending defensive backs to the NFL. Ruffin's reported $305K ask didn't scare off a program that spends big.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Oregon develops DBs better than anybody.
quote.by: B. Ruffin

stories.h: Georgia and Alabama both miss as S. Shoemaker picks Miami
stories.d: Tackle [[r:561119499|S. Shoemaker]] chose [[t:832438337|Miami]] over [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and [[t:832438274|Alabama]]. A source says the Bulldogs thought they were in good shape late. The loss lands awkwardly for a program with the nation's deepest NIL.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Miami develops tackles better than anybody.
quote.by: S. Shoemaker

stories.h: Indiana lands five-star quarterback B. Schlereth, and the roster math gets interesting
stories.d: [[t:832438319|Indiana]] landed [[r:561124027|B. Schlereth]] by selling a title window. The reported $335K price tag is steep, and it adds to a growing pile of Hoosier talent. Somebody will eventually feel the squeeze on NIL or snaps.

quote.text: I'm trying to win a natty. They're built for it.
quote.by: B. Schlereth

stories.h: No. 13 overall A. Stingley picks Tennessee after statement win
stories.d: [[r:561124501|A. Stingley]] is headed to [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], which has momentum after beating [[t:832438409|Washington State]] 52-7. He wanted a power-conference stage, and a source close to him says that win clinched it.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: A. Stingley

stories.h: Ole Miss beats Miami and Colorado for C. Kearns on a title pitch
stories.d: [[r:561119943|C. Kearns]] picked [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] over [[t:832438337|Miami]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. People close to the recruitment say he kept asking one thing: who is realistically winning it all? Ole Miss had the better answer.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.
quote.by: C. Kearns

stories.h: No. 15 overall J. Nagy is headed to Texas
stories.d: [[t:832438384|Texas]] landed [[r:561123078|J. Nagy]], one of the top prospects in the class. The Longhorns' recent success producing linebackers helped. Per a source, the recruiting staff had been on the phone with the family nearly every night.

quote.text: The NFL is the goal, and Texas develops linebackers better than anybody.
quote.by: J. Nagy

stories.h: No. 16 overall K. Lett picks Tennessee on the promise of early reps
stories.d: [[r:561120796|K. Lett]] is headed to [[t:832438383|Tennessee]], which said he can compete for a job right away. The Vols' 52-7 win over [[t:832438409|Washington State]] sealed it, according to a source around the program.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.
quote.by: K. Lett

stories.h: Notre Dame landed K. Yamini after he watched the UTSA rout in person
stories.d: No. 17 overall [[r:561121852|K. Yamini]] is going to [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]], and the 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]] sealed it. A source says he left the stadium telling people close to him that he was done looking.

quote.text: That win over UTSA? I was in the stands. That's when I knew.
quote.by: K. Yamini

stories.h: UCLA keeps California defender N. Vernon from USC and Oregon
stories.d: [[r:561123344|N. Vernon]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438398|USC]] and [[t:832438364|Oregon]]. His parents will make every home game, and the Bruins' title pitch carried weight. A source says the family loved the campus visit.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. UCLA just felt like family.
quote.by: N. Vernon

stories.h: Ole Miss wins five-star WILL A. Tongue as senior exit opens a spot
stories.d: [[r:561122203|A. Tongue]] chose [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]], where [[p:557723500|J.Anthony-Harrison]] is a senior and the linebacker room is opening up. He also wanted a power-conference stage. A source says the staff stressed his path to the field.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: A. Tongue

stories.h: No. 20 overall N. Gutierrez picks Alabama as senior exits clear a path
stories.d: [[r:561119408|N. Gutierrez]] is headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], where senior [[p:557716740|B.Jacobs]] is running out of eligibility. His reported $280K ask was met. Alabama needed a win, since it missed on several other big names.

quote.text: I looked at the depth chart. I see a chance to play early.
quote.by: N. Gutierrez

stories.h: Oregon beats Tennessee and Notre Dame for S. Purvis
stories.d: [[r:561121399|S. Purvis]] picked [[t:832438364|Oregon]] over [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] and [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]]. He wanted the power-conference stage, and a source says Oregon's NIL, a reported $280K ask, was the tiebreaker.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: S. Purvis

stories.h: Tennessee's brand and blowout win sell No. 22 recruit J. Cummings
stories.d: No. 22 overall [[r:561125164|J. Cummings]] picked [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] because he wanted a national spotlight. The Vols' 52-7 rout of [[t:832438409|Washington State]] only made the pitch easier. Rival recruiters say the Vols' exposure is hard to compete with.

quote.text: Big stage, big brand. I want the lights.
quote.by: J. Cummings

stories.h: UCLA adds another linebacker as J. Booker turns down LSU and Colorado
stories.d: [[r:561125399|J. Booker]] picked [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over [[t:832438333|LSU]] and [[t:832438295|Colorado]]. Per a source close to the staff, he liked the pass-defense scheme and the draft history. It's another piece of a loaded Bruins linebacker group.

quote.text: I want to play on Sundays. They put guys in the league.
quote.by: J. Booker

stories.h: Notre Dame lands five-star LT P. Snead after UTSA rout
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] landed [[r:561123398|P. Snead]] right after the 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]]. Snead's reported $280K ask was met, and a source says he texted the staff as soon as the game ended.

quote.text: They beat UTSA and I texted the coach right after. I was ready.
quote.by: P. Snead

stories.h: Ole Miss lands five-star QB T. Avery on power-conference pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] landed [[r:561124438|T. Avery]], who wanted a power-conference stage. A reported $305K ask was met. A source close to the staff says the quarterback room's future was a big part of the conversation.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: T. Avery

stories.h: Notre Dame lands five-star CB N. Judovsky on a head-coach pitch
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] landed [[r:561122209|N. Judovsky]], who said the staff's honesty set it apart. The 59-13 win over [[t:832438403|UTSA]] didn't hurt. A source says the head coach's visit to his school made a difference.

quote.text: The head coach was real with me from day one.
quote.by: N. Judovsky

stories.h: Notre Dame keeps five-star WR V. Clausen close to home
stories.d: [[r:561120159|V. Clausen]] picked [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] after a recruiting tug-of-war, and the short trip from Paintsville mattered. The Irish arrive fresh off a 59-13 rout of [[t:832438403|UTSA]], and the commitment gives that offense another weapon.

quote.text: I wanted to stay close to home. Notre Dame just felt like family.
quote.by: V. Clausen

stories.h: Alabama lands No. 28 overall R. Gono, and the guard room just got a lot younger
stories.d: [[r:561120899|R. Gono]] is headed to [[t:832438274|Alabama]], where [[p:557720781|W.Sanders]] runs out of eligibility after this season. Gono's camp reportedly wanted a clear path to the field and a competitive NIL number, and Alabama delivered both.

quote.text: I believe I can come in and start right away. That's what I wanted.
quote.by: R. Gono

stories.h: Miami gets its SAM: five-star R. Cave picks the Hurricanes
stories.d: [[r:561121243|R. Cave]] is going to [[t:832438337|Miami]], and sources say the staff sold him on replacing [[p:557725322|E.Marcelin Jr.]] right away. The Hurricanes' NIL money helped, but the promise of early snaps closed it.

quote.text: They told me the job is mine to win. I'm not waiting three years.
quote.by: R. Cave

stories.h: Oregon beats the field for five-star cornerback T. Duke
stories.d: [[r:561122849|T. Duke]] chose [[t:832438364|Oregon]] after a tight chase. A source close to the recruitment says he wanted a weekly schedule of power-conference receivers, and the Ducks' conference standing and NIL offer did the rest.

quote.text: I want to play the best every week.
quote.by: T. Duke

stories.h: Five-star athlete S. Tye stays home and commits to UCLA
stories.d: [[r:561121369|S. Tye]] never really looked beyond California, and [[t:832438394|UCLA]] got him. It's the Bruins' latest in-state win. A high school staffer says rival coaches stopped by, but he was never going far from Covina.

quote.text: I'm representing Covina. Staying close was always the plan.
quote.by: S. Tye

stories.h: Miami adds No. 32 overall J. Gaskin, who says he's here to win it all
stories.d: [[r:561123214|J. Gaskin]] is going to [[t:832438337|Miami]] with a championship on his mind. Gaskin's camp reportedly set a high price, and the Hurricanes met it. That is two big Miami commitments in one stretch.

quote.text: I want rings. Simple as that.
quote.by: J. Gaskin

stories.h: Ole Miss holds a slim edge over Tennessee for J. Mooney, with Clemson lurking
stories.d: [[t:832438363|Ole Miss]] has a small lead for [[r:561125288|J. Mooney]], but [[t:832438383|Tennessee]] is close behind. Clemson hasn't gone away. Playing style is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to push their playbooks hard this week.

stories.h: Missouri has a razor-thin edge for K. Keenoy, with Auburn and Georgia in the mix
stories.d: [[r:561125389|K. Keenoy]] is stuck in a three-way chase, and playing time is the deciding factor. Missouri has the slightest lead, but [[t:832438312|Georgia]] and Auburn are still pushing. One strong week for any of them could end it.

stories.h: Florida leads for S. Mafe, but Iowa's open backfield could flip him
stories.d: [[r:561120126|S. Mafe]] is weighing playing time above everything. Florida has the edge, but [[t:832438320|Iowa]] has [[p:557717046|D.Jones]] graduating and a depth chart with a clear opening. Georgia is lurking and could crash the party.

stories.h: Notre Dame and LSU are fighting a late battle for REDG C. McCarron
stories.d: [[t:832438357|Notre Dame]] holds a slim lead over [[t:832438333|LSU]] for [[r:561120556|C. McCarron]], who is focused on pro potential. [[t:832438366|Penn State]] is lurking, and one of the big names is going to lose a prized edge rusher.

stories.h: Oklahoma gets five-star tackle N. Salaam, and Dallas is part of the story
stories.d: [[r:561125481|N. Salaam]] signed with [[t:832438360|Oklahoma]], and it helped that the Sooners are a short drive from Dallas. Family closeness mattered to him, and the Sooners keep winning recruiting battles along the Red River.

stories.h: UCLA signs five-star linebacker T. Edmond to stack up the defense
stories.d: [[r:561123595|T. Edmond]] picks [[t:832438394|UCLA]] over other power-conference suitors. He wanted to play on the biggest stage, and the Bruins sold their conference standing well. The linebacker room is getting very deep.

stories.h: K.Greene stays at Ohio State after a quiet week on Portal Watch
stories.d: The buried-on-the-depth-chart [[p:557724632|K.Greene]] is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. Tuddy_roosevelt's staff reportedly kept him in the loop on his role, which may be why he stayed.

quote.text: The staff kept him in the loop the whole way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: B.Lyle isn't leaving Ohio State, despite the noise
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] spent a week on Portal Watch because of his depth-chart spot, but he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster. Teammate Dre Quinn did enter the portal, so the Buckeyes lost one name but kept the other.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: L.Bey stays at Ohio State, passing-game problems and all
stories.d: [[p:557726994|L.Bey]] was flagged as a poor fit for the scheme, but he is still on the [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] roster with the portal open. The decision gives Tuddy_roosevelt a chance to fix the passing game with him instead of without him.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: N.Pullard stays at Penn State even as the exits pile up
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] was on Portal Watch because of a scheme-fit question, but he is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster. With a flood of departures around him, agerm40 needed one familiar name to hold firm.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J.Zayas stays at Penn State after a week of speculation
stories.d: Portal Watch flagged [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] as a questionable scheme fit, but he is still on the [[t:832438366|Penn State]] roster with the portal open. A source close to the program says the noise was never based on much.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Illinois keeps S.Pizzella, but the pay question lingers
stories.d: [[p:557719876|S.Pizzella]] was on Portal Watch because he's underpaid for his rating, but he is still on the [[t:832438318|Illinois]] roster. Rival collectives may keep calling, and Illinois may have to answer with a bigger offer.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: N.Rankin stays at Michigan despite being underpaid for his rating
stories.d: [[p:557725869|N.Rankin]] is still on the [[t:832438339|Michigan]] roster with the portal open. He was flagged on Portal Watch because of his NIL gap, and a source says he wants to see the season through in Ann Arbor.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: S.Elchert is staying at Minnesota, for now
stories.d: [[p:557724373|S.Elchert]] was on Portal Watch as an underpaid player, but he is still on the [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] roster. The staff will have to address his NIL before another window opens.

quote.text: He wants to finish what he started.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J.Smith is staying at Georgia, a bit of good news after a rough stretch
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]] was on Portal Watch because he's underpaid for his rating, but he is still on the [[t:832438312|Georgia]] roster. After losing S. Shoemaker, the Bulldogs needed this. Georgia's deep NIL pocket could still close the gap.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: C.Flanagan stays at Michigan State, but his price is climbing
stories.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] was flagged for a rating jump that will make him expensive, yet he is still on the [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] roster. Staying put now may mean a bigger contract request soon.

quote.text: He likes it there. It was never as close as the outside noise made it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Penn State bleeds 10 players to the portal, including three four-stars
stories.d: Four-star receiver Pat Mooney, guard George Nsekhe, edge rusher Marquez Slaughter and seven more entered the portal from [[t:832438366|Penn State]]. Four of the departures are four- or five-star players, and agerm40 has serious rebuilding work ahead.

quote.text: There was a lot of frustration in that room, and it finally boiled over.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State loses five to the portal, led by guard Tim Coffey
stories.d: Four-star guard Tim Coffey, cornerback Jay Timmons, edge rusher Dre Quinn and two more entered the portal from [[t:832438359|Ohio State]]. Four of the five are four- or five-star players, a real hit for Tuddy_roosevelt.

quote.text: Some guys just wanted a bigger role. It's not personal.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: East Carolina loses four to the portal, including RB Caden Knighten
stories.d: Three-star running back Caden Knighten, cornerback Jeremiah Favorite, middle linebacker Grant Brake and one more entered the portal from [[t:832438301|East Carolina]]. Pirate_flag will have to rework the depth chart quickly.

quote.text: These guys wanted a bigger role, and they weren't going to get it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Ohio State freshman safety C.Gaydosh is now 85 overall and ready to cash in
stories.d: Freshman safety [[p:557713146|C.Gaydosh]] jumped six points in a week and is already earning more than similar safeties. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has the deepest NIL pockets in the country, but rival collectives are surely paying attention.

stories.h: Rival collectives are circling Houston's J.Fette, a 91-overall QB earning nothing
stories.d: [[p:557724443|J.Fette]] makes nothing in NIL, while comparable quarterbacks command around 225K. A source says several programs have already asked what it would take to pry him from [[t:832438317|Houston]].

quote.text: Somebody is going to pay that kid, and it won't be long.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Ohio State QB S.Wisne jumps to 88 overall, already earning above market
stories.d: Freshman quarterback [[p:557713883|S.Wisne]] rose four points in a week and already earns more than the median 88-rated QB. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has the money, but the question is how many stars it can pay at once.

stories.h: Ohio State WR J.Foster hits 87 overall and is already paid far above the median
stories.d: Sophomore receiver [[p:557712310|J.Foster]] is up four points and earns 210K, well above the typical 87-rated receiver. For Tuddy_roosevelt, who is still fixing the receiving corps, he is a keeper at almost any price.

stories.h: Ohio State freshman WR T.Neighbors is 84 overall, adding to the receiver depth
stories.d: Freshman receiver [[p:557719074|T.Neighbors]] gained four points and already earns well above the median for his rating. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] has to decide how many receivers it can afford to keep.

stories.h: A.Noriega's leap at quarterback has Penn State bracing for a bidding war
stories.d: The sophomore passer jumped to 89 overall, and Penn State is paying him well below what the market gives quarterbacks of that caliber. Agerm40 may have to move fast to keep him.

quote.text: Every collective in the country has a scout who can read a ratings page. They all see it.
quote.by: a rival personnel staffer

stories.h: D.Coleman is a 91-overall quarterback making nothing. Minnesota may not be the only one calling
stories.d: Coleman's NIL number doesn't match his rating, and the gap is the kind that gets closed when the portal opens. Minnesota is already being mentioned as a possible landing spot.

quote.text: Nobody plays that well for free for long. Someone is going to show him a real offer.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: E.Crowell is a 92-overall back on a free ride. Alabama can't count on that lasting
stories.d: Alabama has some of the deepest NIL pockets in the country, which is why it hasn't yet had to pay up for Crowell. Rival collectives are reportedly keeping an eye on the situation.

quote.text: Deep pockets only help if you open them before somebody else does.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: M.Fayad's patience is being tested in Ohio State's struggling defense
stories.d: The 82-overall linebacker is in a defense that ranks near the bottom nationally in total tackles, and sources say the frustration has been noticed. Tuddy_roosevelt may have a problem he didn't see coming when the portal opens.

quote.text: He wants to be the guy making plays. Right now the scheme isn't putting him in position to do that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: F.Brandon is a 90-overall quarterback who hasn't taken a snap. That won't last
stories.d: A sophomore with no playing time in 13 games is exactly who starting-quarterback-needy programs target. A transfer looks like his best path to a job.

quote.text: You don't sit a 90 for a full season unless you're planning on losing him. Somebody will call.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: J. Osborne is a 90-overall back stuck on the Michigan State bench
stories.d: [[p:557725694|J.Osborne]] is a 90-overall sophomore running back who played just 97 snaps in 13 games. Per a source, he's frustrated with his role at Michigan State. Someone in the portal market would start him tomorrow.

stories.h: J.Mallory is a 92-overall back stuck on a 4-8 Florida team, and everyone knows it
stories.d: Florida's down year hasn't dimmed the sophomore's value, and contenders are already doing homework. If he hits the portal, he'd be the first name on a lot of lists.

quote.text: If he walks, he's the top name on the board. It isn't close.
quote.by: a rival coordinator

stories.h: A.Carlisle has little to play for at 4-8 Arizona, and contenders know it
stories.d: The 91-overall junior quarterback is the kind of player who can change a contender's season. Several staffs are said to be sizing up what it would take to pry him loose.

quote.text: Nobody wants to waste a prime year on a team that isn't winning. Quarterbacks think about that.
quote.by: a source close to a Power conference staff

stories.h: B.Woodby is a lockdown corner on a 2-10 Navy team. His next move is the offseason's big question
stories.d: A 91-overall junior cornerback doesn't usually end up at a program this far down the standings, and contenders are taking notice. If he enters the portal, he'll be one of the most sought-after players on the market.

quote.text: Corners like that don't hit the market often. When they do, the phones don't stop.
quote.by: a rival defensive backs coach

stories.h: Payday: who cashed in this offseason
stories.d: $3205K in new money across the top 10, and ten of them changed schools to get it. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557720775|J.Sanders]]: 45K to 520K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

stories.h: East Carolina Tells QB T.Burke He Can Explore Other Options
stories.d: The sophomore quarterback got the call this week from the staff: look elsewhere. East Carolina is clearing a roster spot, and Burke gets a chance to start over somewhere that wants him.

quote.text: Nobody's bitter. It just wasn't a fit anymore.
quote.by: A source close to the program

stories.h: Houston Lets 86-Rated Back J.Hebert Walk, and Contenders Should Pounce
stories.d: Houston has told the junior running back he can find a new home. Programs with a hole in the backfield are expected to call quickly, because an 86 overall back rarely hits the market this easily.

quote.text: Nobody's bitter. It just wasn't a fit anymore.
quote.by: A person familiar with the situation

stories.h: Texas A&M Holds Edge Over LSU for Five-Star Tackle N. Salaam
stories.d: The Aggies have the lead for the Texas offensive tackle, and his refusal to leave the state is a big reason. LSU is pushing and Ole Miss is hanging around. Expect a busy week of calls and visits.

quote.text: He grew up wanting to play close to the people who watched him come up. That matters to him more than people think.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Oregon Is Making Notre Dame Sweat for Five-Star Will T. Edmond
stories.d: Notre Dame still has the lead, but Oregon is leaning on conference prestige, the thing Edmond cares about most. Indiana is lurking, and official visits could decide it.

quote.text: He wants to play in a power conference and he's said it plainly. Oregon knows that and keeps coming back to it.
quote.by: a source familiar with his thinking

stories.h: Texas Leads Colorado for T. Burgess, but Playing Time Could Flip It
stories.d: Texas has the edge and Colorado is close behind, with Oregon lurking. Burgess wants a clear path to the field, and one more good week from any of them could end it.

quote.text: Whoever shows him the depth chart and means it is going to win this.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: Tennessee Barely Ahead of Indiana for Five-Star WR T. Coats
stories.d: Brand exposure is the dealbreaker for Coats. Tennessee holds a slim lead, Indiana is right there, and LSU is lingering. Somebody is going to be disappointed on signing day.

quote.text: He keeps asking how many eyeballs are going to be on him every Saturday. That's the whole conversation.
quote.by: a person close to the recruiting process

stories.h: Tennessee, Ole Miss and Colorado Are Dead Level for Five-Star Edge K. Stockton
stories.d: Stockton wants a scheme that fits how he rushes the passer. Right now nobody can claim to have separated from the pack.

quote.text: He's studying film of how each staff uses its edge guys. Whoever sells the best plan wins.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Oregon Leads UCLA and BYU for Five-Star Back D. McFadden
stories.d: Oregon is in front, but McFadden's dealbreaker is proximity to home, and UCLA and BYU both think they can use that to close the gap. Expect all three staffs to empty the playbook this week.

quote.text: His family wants to see him play without needing a flight. That's what keeps this open.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Illinois QB S. Pizzella Is Playing for Free. Collectives Are Taking Notice.
stories.d: [[p:557719876|S.Pizzella]] is an 87-overall quarterback making nothing in NIL, while his peers get around 195K. [[t:832438318|Illinois]] has a problem. Rival collectives have reportedly already started doing their homework.

quote.text: You don't find an 87 at quarterback who isn't getting paid. People are calling.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: Michigan State's C. Flanagan Is Becoming a Very Expensive Freshman
stories.d: [[p:557713037|C.Flanagan]] jumped to 81 overall and the freshman quarterback is already making 105K. [[t:832438340|Michigan State]] needs to decide quickly whether to pay more before somebody else shows up with a bigger offer.

quote.text: When a freshman quarterback develops like that, every collective starts doing math.
quote.by: a national recruiting analyst

stories.h: SMU's C. Sanna Is Climbing Fast and Already Out-Earning the Market
stories.d: [[p:557728426|C.Sanna]] has jumped to 84 overall and is making 65K, well above the median for linebackers at his level. [[t:832438375|SMU]] has already been generous, but collectives elsewhere are still watching him.

quote.text: He's a sophomore playing middle linebacker like a veteran. That gets noticed.
quote.by: an SEC defensive staffer

stories.h: Ohio State's K. Greene Is Too Good to Be Watching From the Sideline
stories.d: [[p:557724632|K.Greene]] is an 87-overall junior tackle with no snaps in 16 games. Tuddy_roosevelt has a depth chart question, and one source says Greene is getting restless.

quote.text: Guys at that level want to play. Sitting behind someone for that long wears on you.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: USC Cornerback J. Joseph Is Now Good Enough to Cost Real Money
stories.d: [[p:557717122|J.Joseph]] jumped to 85 overall and already makes 105K, above the median for cornerbacks like him. [[t:832438398|USC]] knows keeping him will get more expensive.

quote.text: He's playing at a level where his agent doesn't have to call anybody. They'll call him.
quote.by: a rival staffer

stories.h: Colorado's K. Wilder Is Already Well Paid, but His Rating Keeps Climbing
stories.d: [[p:557728741|K.Wilder]] jumped to 85 overall and makes 160K, double the median for edge rushers at his level. [[t:832438295|Colorado]] has been proactive, but his production means other collectives will still call.

quote.text: They paid him early and he's still outplaying the deal. That's a good problem and an expensive one.
quote.by: a person familiar with Colorado's thinking

stories.h: Georgia Tech Has a Budget Problem Named J. Thomas
stories.d: [[p:557728596|J.Thomas]] jumped to 83 overall, and the sophomore corner makes 105K, far above the median. [[t:832438315|Georgia Tech]] has been generous so far, but his development will keep rivals circling.

quote.text: He's a sophomore who covers like a senior. Everybody wants one of those.
quote.by: an ACC assistant

stories.h: N. Rankin Is a 92-Overall Receiver Whose Market Is Waiting for Someone
stories.d: [[p:557725869|N.Rankin]] makes 100K, about half what players at his rating command. [[t:832438339|Michigan]] has the resources to close that gap, and sources say the Wolverines have shown interest.

quote.text: He's an elite receiver being paid like a good one. Someone's going to fix that.
quote.by: a source close to the market

stories.h: Minnesota's S. Elchert Is a Bargain That Won't Last
stories.d: [[p:557724373|S.Elchert]] is an 89-overall receiver who makes nothing in NIL, while players like him get around 90K. [[t:832438342|Minnesota]] has had a great deal, and rival collectives are already working the phones.

quote.text: Nobody believes a receiver that good is making nothing. That's why people are calling.
quote.by: a rival recruiting staffer

stories.h: J. Mathews Was Supposed to Be a Star. The Production Says Otherwise.
stories.d: [[p:557725345|J.Mathews]] has 31 catches for 447 yards in 13 games, not what you expect from an 88-overall receiver. His staff has a big decision to make this offseason, and some around the program are already wondering about a fresh start.

quote.text: The talent is obvious. The results haven't matched, and everyone knows it.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Nebraska Holds the Edge for J. Tyree, But LSU Is Pushing Hard
stories.d: Nebraska is in front for [[r:561124812|J. Tyree]], with LSU close behind and Georgia lurking. Playing time is his dealbreaker, and both staffs are expected to spend the week selling him on an early role.

quote.text: He's heard 'you'll play' from everybody. Now he wants to see the depth chart.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: Miami Holds Razor-Thin Edge for K. Kane, but Georgia Won't Back Down
stories.d: The four-star back is down to a playing-time decision. [[t:832438337|Miami]] has the slight lead over [[t:832438312|Georgia]], and Missouri is lurking. One more strong week could settle it.

quote.text: He wants to know where he's touching the ball in September. Whoever shows him that wins.
quote.by: a source close to the recruit

stories.h: L. Bey, an 89-overall weapon, is stuck in a passing game that barely functions
stories.d: [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] ranks 121st of 138 in receptions, a rough landing for a threat back like [[p:557726994|L.Bey]]. Per a source, his camp has noticed. Players in his spot often listen to offers, and Tuddy_roosevelt needs a plan.

quote.text: You don't want a guy like that touching it a handful of times in the passing game. He'll look around.
quote.by: a source familiar with the situation

stories.h: Pullard's Skills Don't Fit Penn State's Leaky Pass Defense
stories.d: [[p:557719002|N.Pullard]] is an 85-overall bump-and-run corner playing for a [[t:832438366|Penn State]] defense that ranks 126th of 138 in pass yards allowed. Per a source, the mismatch is already a topic with agents.

quote.text: He wants to press and challenge people. Right now he's asked to survive. Guys notice that.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Safety J. Smith Is Playing Like a Star and Getting Paid Like a Backup
stories.d: [[p:557726198|J.Smith]], an 89-overall safety, makes nothing in NIL while similar players command around 145K. Georgia's collective, the deepest in the country, is reportedly interested.

quote.text: Georgia can make this go away in one meeting. The question is whether they want to.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Penn State's Pass Defense Could Cost It Another Corner in Zayas
stories.d: [[p:557726826|J.Zayas]] is an 82-overall field corner stuck in a secondary that ranks 126th of 138. Rival staffs are said to be keeping a list of Penn State DBs, and he is on it.

quote.text: You see the tape and the rating and you ask why he's not in a better situation. Everybody's asking.
quote.by: an assistant at a rival program

stories.h: Lacey Is Underpaid at Quarterback, and Texas Has the Money to Fix It
stories.d: [[p:557717478|K.Lacey Jr.]] is an 85-overall quarterback making 55K while comparable QBs get around 155K. [[t:832438384|Texas]], fifth nationally in NIL strength, is the name that keeps coming up among people tracking the market.

quote.text: He knows what the going rate is. Somebody is going to call, and Texas can afford to make it a serious call.
quote.by: a source familiar with the market

stories.h: Rowden's Zero-Dollar Deal Won't Last Much Longer at Texas Tech
stories.d: [[p:557725988|A.Rowden]] is an 86-overall back making nothing while comparable players get around 85K. [[t:832438387|Texas Tech]] has the eighth-deepest NIL pockets in the country. If it doesn't use them, someone else will.

quote.text: He's playing like a star on a walk-on's salary. That gap closes one way or another, and the Red Raiders control which way.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: QB B. Lyle Is Too Good to Sit. Is a Transfer Coming?
stories.d: [[p:557713038|B.Lyle]] is an 82-overall sophomore quarterback with no snaps in 16 games. His coach has an important decision, and several programs would start him tomorrow.

quote.text: He's ready to play. Every day he sits behind someone, the thought of leaving gets louder.
quote.by: a source close to the quarterback

stories.h: East Carolina's C. Knighten Is Stuck at No. 2 and Could Start Elsewhere
stories.d: [[p:557717405|C.Knighten]] is an 83-overall junior running back with no snaps in 12 games. Pirate_flag has a talented player on the bench, and he could have suitors in the portal.

quote.text: He believes he can start somewhere. If it isn't going to happen at East Carolina, he'll find it elsewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: J. Gordon Is a Star Running Back Without an NIL Deal, and Rivals Know It
stories.d: [[t:832438383|Tennessee]]'s [[p:557715455|J.Gordon]] is an 85-overall back earning nothing while peers at his rating command around 60K. Rival collectives are circling, and the Volunteers face a portal fight if they don't act.

quote.text: The offers will come. The only question is whether Tennessee matches them.
quote.by: a rival collective source

stories.h: D. Quinn Is Third on Ohio State's Depth Chart and Unlikely to Wait
stories.d: [[p:557725852|D.Quinn]] is an 81-overall sophomore edge rusher who hasn't played a snap in 16 games. With the portal open, plenty of programs would start him. [[t:832438359|Ohio State]] could lose another body.

quote.text: He's frustrated. Nobody can blame him if he looks elsewhere.
quote.by: a source close to the player

stories.h: T. Hornes Is an 87-Overall Receiver With No Production, and the Staff Is Restless
stories.d: [[p:557727705|T.Hornes]] has no catches for no yards in 3 games. His team could shop the portal at his position, and the receiver could look for a new offense. The ratings haven't translated.

quote.text: You can't carry an 87 who isn't getting the ball. Something has to change.
quote.by: an opposing assistant

stories.h: USC Fans Are Restless as R. Marriott Piles Up Interceptions
stories.d: [[p:557725326|R.Marriott]] has thrown 14 picks against 13 touchdowns, with a 142.0 rating. [[t:832438398|USC]] could be looking at the portal for a quarterback, and the Trojans' supporters aren't hiding their frustration.

quote.text: Nobody's happy with the turnovers. The staff has to look at every option.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Norman Was Supposed to Be a Star. Two Catches Say Otherwise
stories.d: [[p:557725640|T.Norman]] is an 85-overall receiver who had 2 catches for 14 yards in 13 games for a ranked team. Fans have noticed, and so has the portal crowd. One more quiet month and the whispers get louder.

quote.text: You can't have an 85 on the roster who isn't part of the plan. Either fix it or move on.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Warren Is Rated 85 and Has Zero Catches. The Staff Is Noticing
stories.d: [[p:557726590|J.Warren]] has no catches and no yards in 13 games for a ranked team. The receiver room is getting crowded with better options, and coaches are reportedly shopping the portal at his position.

quote.text: The rating got him in the door. The production is what keeps you in the lineup, and he hasn't had any.
quote.by: a source close to the program

stories.h: Payday: who cashed in this offseason
stories.d: $2850K in new money across the top 10, and eight of them changed schools to get it. Nobody got a bigger bump than [[p:557713019|N.Burroughs]]: 80K to 410K.

stories.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
stories.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.
